module_summary: AXI4-lite PicoRV32 wrapper: the picorv32 core's native valid/ready memory bus is bridged by a picorv32_axi_adapter child onto AW/W/B/AR/R channels; PCPI, IRQ and trace pass straight through.

anchors.name: mem_valid
anchors.why: Native bus request from core to adapter; launches AXI read or write channels.

anchors.name: mem_ready
anchors.why: Adapter completion back to core, ending the native memory transfer.

anchors.name: mem_addr
anchors.why: Native bus address from core, forwarded to AXI awaddr/araddr.

anchors.name: mem_wdata
anchors.why: Native store data from core, forwarded to AXI wdata.

anchors.name: mem_rdata
anchors.why: Load/fetch data returned from adapter (AXI rdata) to the core.

anchors.name: mem_wstrb
anchors.why: Byte write strobes; nonzero selects AXI write versus read path.

anchors.name: mem_instr
anchors.why: Instruction-fetch flag mapped to AXI prot bits by the adapter.

anchors.name: mem_axi_awvalid
anchors.why: AXI write-address valid driven by adapter for core stores.

anchors.name: mem_axi_arvalid
anchors.why: AXI read-address valid driven by adapter for core loads and fetches.

anchors.name: mem_axi_wvalid
anchors.why: AXI write-data valid from the adapter.

anchors.name: mem_axi_wdata
anchors.why: AXI write data carrying core store data.

anchors.name: mem_axi_rvalid
anchors.why: AXI read response valid; completes core read via mem_ready.

anchors.name: mem_axi_rdata
anchors.why: AXI read data returned to core through the adapter.

anchors.name: mem_axi_bvalid
anchors.why: AXI write response valid; completes core store via mem_ready.

anchors.name: pcpi_valid
anchors.why: Co-processor request passthrough; inactive with ENABLE_PCPI=0.

anchors.name: trace_valid
anchors.why: Trace stream valid passthrough; inactive with ENABLE_TRACE=0.

groups.name: cpu_core
groups.description: picorv32 core executing RV32I, issuing native bus requests; PCPI/IRQ/trace passthrough.

groups.name: native_mem_bus
groups.description: Internal valid/ready memory bus linking the core to the AXI adapter.

groups.name: axi_bridge
groups.description: picorv32_axi_adapter converting native transfers into AXI4-lite channel handshakes.
